title: observability: add token-level cost/latency breakdowns, KV cache metrics, dashboards and alert tuning
description: Adds token-level cost and latency metrics (per-route and per-model), KV-cache hit/miss metrics, distributed tracing spans for serving runtime hot paths, new Grafana dashboards for token-level breakdowns, and tuned alert rules. Motivation: provide SREs and platform engineers better visibility into token economics and runtime behavior to reduce cost regressions and improve incident response. Changes include new Prometheus metrics, tracing instrumentation, dashboard JSON, alert thresholds with runbooks, migration script for existing dashboards, unit + integration tests, and documentation updates. Checklist: 1) add metrics & spans; 2) add dashboards and migration; 3) tune alerts with noise reduction; 4) update docs and onboarding playbook; 5) e2e test coverage. Related Linear items: ENG-8273, ENG-8311, PM-210. This PR consolidates prior token-level metrics work and introduces KV-specific metrics to help identify cold-cache vs compute regressions.
author: Sofia Martinez

notes_on_deployment: Dashboard migration script should be run during low traffic window. Alert changes are staged to non-prod first; escalation policies updated. Ops runbook added to docs/observability/token_metrics.md.
implementation_notes:
- Metrics are exposed via Prometheus with route_id and model_version labels.
- Token cost computed server-side using per-token emitter which multiplies token_count by per-token price estimate for the active model profile.
- KV metrics track hits, misses, and lookup latency percentiles.
- Tracing adds spans for request dispatch, model timing, and KV lookup to allow distributed trace correlation.
- Dashboard provides per-route breakdown and heatmap of token cost vs latency.
- Alerts tuned to 15m rolling median and require sustained 3x baseline increase before paging.
how_to_test: Run unit tests in tests/unit and pytest for tests/integration. To validate dashboards locally, import grafana JSON into a sandbox Grafana and run migration script against test DB. Simulate cold/warm KV by toggling kv:force_miss flag in tests.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: metric cardinality increase. Mitigation: explicit label hygiene (route_id/model_version only), sampling for traces, and metric aggregation for long term storage. Risk: alert noise during rollout — mitigated by staged rollout to non-prod and 15m rolling median threshold.
